name: Eagle Eyed Awareness
body:
Your vision and reaction time is comparable to the most prolific of avian predators.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (Perception)

Benefit(s): You may roll a perception check with a -5 penalty to determine your initiative. Any non-Dexterity bonus you have to initiative checks applies to this Perception check.
